tasks.task: Harvest search terms and build the negatives list

items.when: When the export has text numbers, odd dates or duplicate rows that would skew the sort
When you have a search term report and need harvest, negative and watch lists
Weekly or fortnightly, to get harvest and negative lists ready for bulk upload
When you want a second sort of winners and negatives to compare against your own
When you need a quick waste score on one report before the full harvest

tasks.task: Work out break-even ACOS for every product

items.when: When landed cost is a guess, to get cost per sellable unit from the quote and freight
At the start of any job, or monthly, before judging any campaign
When you want every Amazon fee listed by size tier and the margin scored
When one product's number looks off, to redo profit per unit and break-even ad cost
When a target sits right on break-even, to ask how much room for error is left

tasks.task: Review ACOS and TACOS against each product's margin

items.when: When each product must be labelled profitable, break-even, losing money or too new to call
When stock days matter too, to grade each SKU and set its ad target or clearance plan
When ad-reported sales look too good, to compare them with total sales
When ACOS looks fine but profit does not, to ask what the number leaves out
Before the review is shared, to check the method and the sums

tasks.task: Design or rebuild a Sponsored Products structure

items.when: Before a rebuild, to see what exists, where it overlaps and what it wastes
When you have a keyword export, to pick the phrases each product should target
When the account needs campaigns split by product and match type with a naming rule
When you want a second structure with starting bids and negatives to compare
Before anything is built, to give the client a numbered list to approve

tasks.task: Map a messy account and plan the clean-up

items.when: When years of auto campaigns overlap and products are mixed in one campaign
When you have the exports, to list wasted spend and the campaigns that stand out
When the account is busy but flat, to find the one thing holding growth back
Before the map, to catch gaps, duplicates and odd values in the bulk export
When the clean-up is planned and each pause, merge and move needs sign-off

tasks.task: Write bid and budget rules for launch, growth and defend

items.when: Before any rule, to fix the ACOS each product can afford in each phase
When each product needs rules for when to raise, hold, cut or pause, by phase
When budget must move between campaigns, to compare three plans with change limits
When defend spend is under attack, to ask which sales the ads really caused
When the rules are drafted and the client must agree the limits you may act within
Once a week on the same day, and twice in the first week of a launch
When this week's search term export is in
When you compare this week's costs and clicks with past weeks to flag what to look at
At the end of the routine, to list this week's changes for approval or report them

tasks.task: Plan the ads for a product launch

items.when: When a product goes live in four to eight weeks, or has just gone live with no ads
When you have keywords and a daily budget and need the first campaigns with bids
When ads must line up with the days before and after go-live
When the launch needs a set time and budget at a higher ACOS, then a hand-over to growth
Before the launch budget is set, to check what the product can afford to lose
In the first week of each month, covering the month just ended
When each product's actual ACOS and TACOS must be set against its break-even
When fee, stock and sales reports should be checked for margin slips in the same pass
Before the review is sent, to catch formula errors and broken links in the workings

tasks.task: Write a change request the client can approve

items.when: When your analysis must become a numbered list the client approves item by item
When the client asks which changes you may make alone and which need a yes first
Before the upload sheet is shared, to find broken totals and wrong rows

tasks.task: Write Sponsored Brands headlines and a video brief

items.when: When the headline is open, to get five short lines that each take a new angle
When you need plain headlines with character counts and the one to test first
When a video is planned, to see four kinds of script before one is written
When the video will play muted in search results, to check it still sells
Before submitting a headline, image or video script, to catch claims that need proof
When the copy has many claims, to sort each as fine, needs proof or cut

tasks.task: Plan product targeting and Sponsored Display

items.when: Before choosing rival products to target, to see where yours is clearly stronger
When product-targeting campaigns need their place and names in the structure
When display ads will follow past visitors, to plan one message per doubt
When display sales are counted on views, to judge them against margin with care

tasks.task: Find why ad results dropped or costs jumped

items.when: When a number moved, to confirm the change, split it by group and rank the drivers
When the cause is unclear, to test six possible causes and say how sure you are
When you want a second read that names one bottleneck and the fix to try first
When the change may be seasonal, to separate trend, season and odd spikes

tasks.task: Plan ad budget and pacing for a sale event

items.when: When a big sale is coming and you need a cost limit, an offer ladder and daily pacing
When you have last year's sale data and need scale, hold and cut rules by day
When the budget is not fixed, to see low and high cases with diminishing returns
When the event needs its own bid rules and a date to return to normal
When prices drop for the sale, to redo break-even ACOS at the sale price
When the numbers are ready and need trends, wins, misses and what to change next
When the client wants a fuller report with open issues and owners for next steps
When a trend needs a clean chart drawn from the export
Before making a scale, hold or cut call, to check you are not misreading a metric
Before the report is sent, to check the method, the sums and any bias

tasks.task: Test whether ads add sales or take organic ones

items.when: When you can hold ads back on some products or regions and read the difference
When any bid or budget change should be run as a test with a clear way to read it
When brand-term ads look cheap, to ask whether those sales would have come anyway
When the test data is in, to check the split and give a call with a range

tasks.task: Build the keyword list for a product

items.when: When you have a keyword export and must choose which phrases to target and where
When you want the exact words buyers use for why they bought
When the obvious keywords are costly, to find searches page one serves badly
When past campaigns exist and their converting searches should seed the list

tasks.task: Check a listing is ready before spending on ads

items.when: When clicks do not convert, to compare the listing with rivals and rank the fixes
When images may be holding conversion back or risk a rejection
When reviews may explain a weak conversion rate, to rank the complaints
When the listing cannot be fixed yet, to decide if ads should run on it at all

tasks.task: Clean and check ad exports before analysis

items.when: When exports have text numbers, mixed dates and duplicate rows
When you need gaps, duplicates and odd values listed before any sum is trusted
When the file is large and you want to ask it questions and chart it in plain words
When your own workbook joins several exports, to catch broken formulas

always.when: Before any finding goes to the client, to check the method and the sums
When a report or ad states a number or claim you cannot trace to the client's data

helpers.when: When the listing, price, stock or account health is the real problem, not the ads
When Sponsored Brands or video ads need concepts, angles and a test plan
When weak images hold conversion back and a new image set is needed
When ad data must be joined with store, stock and profit data across channels
When the weekly exports need a reusable workbook or bulk sheet template
When no ACOS target works at the current price and the price itself must change
